steps: Rinse 200 g quinoa under cold water; set aside. Dice the onion and mince the 2 garlic cloves.
Cut 350 g chicken into 1 cm cubes. Measure 300 g green peas (thawed if frozen).
Heat 15 ml olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Cook the diced onion and minced garlic for 3 minutes, until softened and fragrant.
Add the chicken cubes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until no pink remains.
Stir in the rinsed quinoa, 400 ml unsalted vegetable broth, 2 g cumin, and 1 g salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the green peas; cover and cook 3 more minutes, until peas are tender and bright.
Remove from heat; drizzle with 15 ml lemon juice and fluff with a fork.
Serve warm. Yields about 4 family portions; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.
